domain_policy.ci: strict original per-ion Tmin[eV]..Tmax[keV], conversion retains original source constant; outside range is error
domain_policy.pi: zero below fit Eth; evaluate through Emax; above Emax is error; negative or nonfinite energy rejected
domain_policy.rr: 3..1e9 K for selected low-Z entries; sparse Option means unprovided coefficient, not zero
domain_policy.original_cfit_u80_cutoff: not encountered inside selected strict valid temperature ranges; not extended into low-temperature simulations
domain_policy.underflow: positive nonnormal output is ArithmeticFailure, never silently structural zero

energy_ownership: CI dE and PI fit Eth are coefficient-fit parameters, not newly adopted binding energies. No chemical/thermal/escape/geometry ledger is modified.
missing_before_network_admission: binding energy owner with stage identity
